title: Haloumi Chopped Salad
subtitle: with Black Barley and Sunflower Seeds
description: With a trio of super healthy grains – rice, quinoa and barley – plus crunchy celery and sunflower seeds, sweet currants and golden haloumi, this salad is oh so good and good for you.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a small saucepan of water to the boil for the grain blend (see Kitchen notes). Thinly slice the celery and half the onion. Cut the haloumi into 1cm-thick slices. Crush 1 garlic clove.

Cook grain blend: Cook the grain blend in the pan of boiling water for 20-22 mins until tender. Drain. Meanwhile, put half the sunflower seeds (see Kitchen notes) in a cold medium frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan, reserving the pan. Cool slightly, then coarsely chop.
Make dressing: Put the garlic, 2 tbs balsamic vinegar and 2 tsp olive oil in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.
Fry haloumi: Spray or brush the reserved pan with olive oil and heat over medium heat. Cook the haloumi for 1-2 mins each side until golden. Remove the pan from the heat.

Serve up: Add the celery, onion, grain blend, salad leaves and currants to the dressing and toss gently to combine. Divide among bowls and top with the haloumi. Sprinkle over the sunflower seeds and enjoy!

Kitchen notes: Our grain blend contains black barley, a highly nutritious grain with a nutty, slightly sweet flavour and chewy texture. It is the only grain that can go from field to fork without any processing. ~ To keep within our healthy eating guidelines, we've used only half of the sunflower seeds. However, if you wish to use them all, the dish will still taste delicious.
